integrity: Analytic proof with independent exact rational generator and Laplace cross-checks; numerical examples are illustrative and not substitutes for the all-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the autonomous integer-valued degree master-equation chain; not an exact finite-network theorem. Ordinary degree convexity is distinct from curvature on a logarithmic plot. Fixed-rate large-target asymptotics are not uniform in vanishing reset rate. Equivalent older queueing specialization remains a priority risk.
title: Exact threshold-hitting times and strict degree convexity in a resetting network-growth model
